response.original_title: American Cruise Lines Customer Service Escalation: Refunds, Billing & Booking
response.overview: To escalate an issue with American Cruise Lines, call their official customer service line at 866-254-7549 or email Inquiry@AmericanCruiseLines.com for existing bookings. Official Contact Channels Phone Support: 866-254-7549(Monday–Friday 8:00 am – 9:30 pm, Saturday 8:00 am – 8:30 pm, Sunday 8:30 am – 7:00 pm EST) General & Booking Inquiries: Inquiry@AmericanCruiseLines.com Customer Service Email: CustomerService@americancruiselines.com Reservations & Cancellations: Reservations@AmericanCruiseLines.com Fax: 866-254-7549 Steps to Escalate Refunds & Billing Prepare Documents: Gather your customer ID, account number, booking confirmation 866-254-7549, and written records of any prior communications or payment receipts.
